tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '.stack_frames[]' samples.jsonl | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -40
jq -r '[.value, .stack_frames[0], .stack_frames[2], .stack_frames[3]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$2; if($1>0){p[k]+=$1;pn[k]++}else{n[k]+=-$1;nn[k]++}} END{for(k in p) printf "%s'"\\tbad=%d\\tgood=%d\\tnet=%d\\n\",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k]}' | sort -t= -k4,4nr | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -s 'def side("'$s): map(select(if $s=="bad" then .value>0 else .value<0 end)); {bad_operations:(side("bad")|map(.value)|add), good_operations:(side("good")|map(-.value)|add), bad_repeated:(side("bad")|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|.value)|add), good_repeated:(side("good")|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|-.value)|add), bad_sessions_with_repeated:(side("bad")|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length), good_sessions_with_repeated:(side("good")|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length), all_bad_sessions:(side("bad")|map(.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length), all_good_sessions:(side("good")|map(.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length)}'"' samples.jsonl
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.value,.stack_frames[2],.stack_frames[3]]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$2" | "$3;if($1>0)p[k]+=$1;else n[k]+=-$1} END{for(k in p) printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",p[k]-n[k],p[k],n[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -20"
